GOV-F-004-S101.title: Append-Only Audit Storage Layer (Mongo Collection + Constraints)
GOV-F-004-S101.description: Implement the underlying MongoDB collection and repository layer for audit logs with enforced append-only behavior (no updates/deletes), indexed by trace_id, timestamp, and actor, and aligned with existing Mongo utility patterns.
GOV-F-004-S101.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py (Mongo lifecycle + write patterns); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py (existing persistence approach); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S102.title: Trace ID Propagation Middleware Across AI Execution Paths
GOV-F-004-S102.description: Introduce middleware/utilities to generate and propagate a consistent trace_id across FastAPI requests, tool_router executions, Brain runner flows, and downstream services to ensure full audit traceability.
GOV-F-004-S102.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py (request lifecycle); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_router.py (execution flow); Code/Shared/brain_runner.py (orchestration entrypoint); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S103.title: Audit Event Validation and Sanitization Layer
GOV-F-004-S103.description: Add a validation and sanitization layer to ensure all audit events conform to schema, strip or de-identify sensitive data where required, and reject malformed or unsafe payloads before persistence.
GOV-F-004-S103.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_models (Pydantic validation patterns); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/shared/consent/consent_service.py (de-identification patterns); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004
